svg.text: 24 x 40 native. Six colours. Nothing here needs a curve.
hair and mask carry the whole read
The mask is the clock. 10px still resolves 8 directions.
Hand angle = Remaining. Pre-draw 8 or 12 frames;
never rotate a pixel sprite at runtime.
Palette - six values, no ramps yet
Gold appears in exactly two places, so the white
reclaim gauge stays the brightest thing on screen.
Cut from the concept: brass gearwork, rune hems,
mechanical hands, layered drapery. None survive 24px.
